items.title: Joey Calderazzo Trio and The New World at La Villette

items.title: Linear spatiotemporal IDs and temporal-information loss in Video-LLM projectors
items.summary: Causal probes identify linearly bound spatial and temporal IDs in VLM activations; a separate Arrow-of-Time diagnostic locates a major temporal bottleneck in multimodal projectors.

items.title: Algebraic effects and handlers
items.summary: Effect operations state what a computation requests while handlers interpret the request and may resume its delimited continuation, enabling typed composable control abstractions.

items.title: Cracking-assisted transfer printing for quantum-dot displays
items.summary: Controlled nanoscale cracks separate dense quantum-dot films into high-resolution cadmium-free RGB pixels without cross-contamination.

items.title: Correlated Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb risk; French pesticide veto points
items.summary: Simultaneous threats to Gulf and Red Sea passages convert rerouting into correlated chokepoint risk; France's pesticide dispute maps divided control among minister, president, parliament and regulator.

items.title: Turkey's consumer-confidence improvement remains below the optimism threshold
items.summary: The index rose 2.2% to 89.8, its highest since May 2023, but remains pessimistic and contains weaker present-finance and durable-spending signals.

items.title: Lenin on the democratic republic as capitalism's political shell
items.summary: The passage argues that capitalist power can become durable through impersonal institutions that survive electoral changes rather than relying on personal rule.

items.title: Wollstonecraft on justice rather than charity; Du Bois on the colour line
items.summary: Wollstonecraft shifts attention from discretionary relief to structures producing dependence; Du Bois treats racial hierarchy as an institutional boundary across labour, citizenship and education.

items.title: j'avoue
items.summary: A casual standalone agreement marker meaning true, fair or I know right, distinct from its literal confession sense.

items.title: The Deir el-Medina strike
items.summary: Around 1157 BCE, skilled royal tomb workers collectively stopped work after delayed grain wages, leaving the earliest surviving record of a labour strike.

items.title: Condorcet cycle
items.summary: Three individually consistent rankings can generate a cyclic pairwise majority relation, giving the agenda setter power over the final collective choice.
